description: We would be delighted to welcome you to this charming duplex private townhouse with a private garden. Located in the heart of the Latin Quarter, facing the Luxembourg Gardens, it combines classic elegance with modern amenities and can accommodate up to 8 guests.The spaceThis private townhouse is arranged over two levels and benefits from access to a pleasant private garden, offering a calm and rare setting in the heart of the Latin Quarter. Spacious and comfortable, it combines classic charm with modern amenities for a pleasant stay.It consists of:- A large living room with a video projector and home cinema, as well as board games for relaxing moments.- A dining room that can accommodate up to 8 guests.- A fully equipped kitchen: refrigerator, freezer, oven, microwave, washing machine, dryer, dishwasher Nespresso coffee machine, and kettle.- Three large bedrooms with double beds, as well as a single sofa bed.- Two bathrooms.- Two separate toilets.- High-speed Internet connection (WiFi).- Bed linens and towels are provided for your stay.Guest accessMetro:- Odéon (lines 4, 10)- Cluny - La Sorbonne (line 10)- Saint-Michel (line 4)RER:- Luxembourg (RER B)- Saint-Michel - Notre-Dame (RER B, RER C)Bus:- Lines 21, 27, 38, 47, 75, 86, 87Other things to noteYour arrival is self check-in: the door is equipped with a secure system and a entry code. – hotel-type listing
